purpose: Determine whether the prospectively selected Stage32 PPARG MD receptor panel produces reproducible functional subset landscapes in which a strong greedy baseline misses the exact optimum.

folds.algorithm: Within each label, sort unique split_group_id values by SHA-256 of assignment_seed|label|split_group_id and assign cyclically to folds 0,1,2,3.

normalization.algorithm: For every outer fold, scenario, and receptor, fit an empirical midrank CDF on outer-train docking scores only; transform both train and holdout scores with that frozen CDF; lower fractions are more favorable.
normalization.holdout_tie_rule: (count of train scores strictly lower + 0.5*count equal + 0.5)/(train_count+1)
normalization.set_aggregation: minimum normalized rank fraction across selected receptors

scenarios.primary: median score across seed0, seed1, and seed2
scenarios.sensitivity: minimum score across seed0, seed1, and seed2
scenarios.robust_utility: (primary BEDROC20 + mean seed BEDROC20 + worst seed BEDROC20)/3

landscape.exact_oracle: Enumerate every receptor subset independently at each size and break objective ties by lexicographically sorted receptor IDs.
landscape.strong_greedy: For each target size, grow a path from every possible singleton by best robust-utility addition, apply deterministic best-improvement one-swap local search until convergence, and retain the best final solution; break all ties lexicographically.

stage33_gate.decision: Stage33 QUBO model construction is authorized only when at least two subset sizes satisfy every frozen train-gap, fold-replication, and holdout-transfer criterion.

interpretation_boundary: Stage32a evaluates a small balanced PPARG development-training pilot and can only authorize or reject a subsequent train-only QUBO modeling stage. It cannot establish prospective efficacy, cross-target transfer, clinical relevance, quantum speedup, or quantum advantage.
